Task: Consider the underlying intent of the search
Description: Understand the purpose behind the user's query '{query}'

Task: Measure how well the content matches a likely intent of the query (M)
Description: Evaluate the relevance of the passage '{passage}' to the user's query

Task: Measure how trustworthy the web page is (T)
Description: Assess the credibility of the passage '{passage}'

Task: Consider the aspects above and the relative importance of each, and decide on a final score (O)
Description: Combine the results of M and T to produce a final score for the passage

Task: Strictly produce a JSON array of scores without providing any reasoning
Description: Output a JSON array in the format {{"M": score, "T": score, "O": score}}
